evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search method (fingerprinting) and goal compared to other search stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Different personalization basis (user profile) compared to other stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative-filtering style recommendation distinct from other search approaches.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: Search-by-example for music/ringback tones is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Uses enriched metadata/image tags as the retrieval signal, different from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Uploading/tag persistence requirement is distinct from search/recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: UI requirement (thumbnails) different from analysis/identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: General 'similar' info requirement; distinguishes from other, more specific similarity variants.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates ZO-008 (same actor/goal/context); 'perceptually' is not a meaningful difference in actor, context, goal, permission, or business rule.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommender based on similar profiles is distinct from other recommendation/story types.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations driven by local news events differ in trigger and scope from profile-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a distinct detection/metadata requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification differs from person/product/logo requirements by target object.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is a specific detection task distinct from general brand detection.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: General brand identification differs from broadcaster-logo-specific requirement.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Search-by-image (recommend related videos) is a unique interaction pattern.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geo-based discovery is a distinct contextual search requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct input modality requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin validation/editing of segmentation is distinct from automated segmentation tasks tied to specific projects.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction for news segments is a specific editorial requirement.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is distinct from prefilter/search tasks using low-level asset info.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Detection of edited audio is a specialized analysis separate from other audio/image tasks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a specific content-safety requirement distinct from other prefilters.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Generic low-level asset prefiltering differs from project-specific preclassification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is a distinct legal/compliance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset prefiltering and other tasks.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Assessment of interest/appeal is a different analytic goal than prompting or classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists is a notification/workflow requirement distinct from general assessments.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-typology identification is a specific classification requirement.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification for Galaxy Zoo is contextualized and distinct from generic prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific empty-image detection for Snapshot Serengeti differs by context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Timestamp malfunction series detection is a distinct diagnostic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is a distinct machine-learning task for that project.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification differs from species/number detection by target attributes.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct detection/estimation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Automated plankton segmentation/localization is project- and task-specific and distinct from admin editing of segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific empty-image detection differs by dataset and goal.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a distinct measurement task within the Plankton Portal context.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is a unique classification requirement distinct from size/orientation/localization.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis to shorten videos is a specialized processing requirement for Worm Watch Lab.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event detection (egg-laying) is a distinct scientific-extraction requirement different from motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite imagery is a unique analytic goal.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by volunteer experience is a distinct trust/aggregation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Image artefact removal is a specific prefiltering task distinct from other image processing stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a distinct detection requirement.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio noise removal is distinct from other audio/image analysis tasks.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Audio clustering for whale calls is a project-specific analytic need distinct from other audio tasks.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a distinct estimation task different from grouping/categorization.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing of interruptions is a distinct decision requirement from interruption modality or education content.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Specifies interruption modality, which is a different dimension than 'when' to interrupt.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing of education is distinct from interruption or content-format decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Specifies education modality, distinct from when to educate or which content to give.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selection of the educational item/content is a distinct requirement from timing or modality.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is a content-analysis requirement distinct from other notifications.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot-comment timing is a distinct automation/behavior requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Bot explanation timing differs from deciding to comment or what to say.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Content generation for Zoonibot is distinct from timing and trigger detection requirements.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: General subject grouping/clustering is a distinct function; not duplicative of project-specific grouping tasks.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is a different recommender objective than recommending content items.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is a distinct content-processing requirement.
